audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill on rows 0-5 with only row 6 given to Orianna, while content win[] and the packet chart read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Orianna/Orianna/Orianna.
audit.why: Karma's 950-range Q beats an 815-range Command: Attack pre-6; Command: Shockwave (110/95/80) is a real level-6 swing Karma has no equivalent to, and at 41.51% over 53 games the late game is not Karma's.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma, phases[4..5].side to Orianna; row 6 already agrees.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why describe Karma's Mantra rank and Blackfire spike on rows the chart hands to Orianna, and the content layer calls Mantra "non-damaging".
audit.why: Mantra-Q deals damage — Karma's passive reduces Mantra's cooldown off her damaging abilities. The real level-6 story is Shockwave arriving while Karma gains only a Mantra rank.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Shockwave's 110s cooldown and Command: Attack's 3s cooldown at rank 5 versus Karma's 5-9s Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit and no Orianna ability is named anywhere. Nothing states the defining mechanic: Shockwave launches you toward the ball, not toward Orianna.
audit.why: Riot's text for Command: Shockwave says it launches nearby enemies towards the Ball after a short delay — so the ball's position, not Orianna's, decides whether a step-up is safe. Command: Protect is a flat 9s shield at 1095 range that also damages on the way, which is what absorbs the RQ chunk.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field carries R 110/95/80, Q 7/6/5/4/3, E flat 9s, and the ball-position rule replaces the vague "fight-flipping wombo" line.
